ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of a receipt to attach it to an entry. Photos stay on your phone.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kopiyka only uses your location while the app is open, to suggest the category you used near where you are. It never tracks you in the background.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Kopiyka only uses your location while the app is open, to suggest the category you used near where you are. It never tracks you in the background.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Remember where you log expenses so the category can be suggested next time.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kopiyka doesn't record audio. Receipt photos are taken with sound off.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Kopiyka doesn't use motion or fitness data.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach a receipt you already photographed.
